prefill.value:
I run SOMA Studios, a film and software studio where the crew is me and a team of AIs. We build in public: short funny films, the apps behind them, and a running show about how it all gets made. If you have an idea, bring it and your AI, and leave with something finished. Big project? Book a call. Small one? Come to a Room. somastudios.ai

Before this: embedded systems research at MIT, and a long career of being right at inconvenient moments. I write irreverently at 70 Years. WTF.
